IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Higher Education (originally sponsored by Representatives Kenney, Cox, Ormsby, Rodne, Williams, Upthegrove and McDermott)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a study of statewide student organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a statewide student association; and creatingnew sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that students atWashington's public fouryear institutions of higher education shouldhave the opportunity to participate in debates, discussion, and thepolicymaking process regarding higher education through theirdesignated student representatives. (2) The legislature further finds that, as a statewide studentassociation, the Washington student lobby has had notable successes,but faces financial challenges that threaten its sustainability andstability. (3) Therefore, the legislature intends to explore alternativemodels of providing for active and regular participation in statepolicymaking by students at fouryear institutions of higher education.

The higher education coordinating boardshall conduct a study of statewide student associations representingstudents at public fouryear institutions of higher education. The p. 1 SHB 2107study shall include but not be limited to: Role and mission, fundingmechanisms, activities and budget, oversight and accountability, andgovernance. In conducting the study, the board shall work withrepresentatives from the Washington student lobby, campus studentgovernment associations, and the fouryear institutions of highereducation. The board shall submit a report with alternative models forhow Washington students could be represented to the higher educationcommittees of the legislature by December 1, 2005.
